_header: IH35-TMS LAW REGISTRY — the machine-readable index of rules that are actually ENFORCED.
THE PHASED RULE (owner-locked 2026-08-05): from this point on, a NEW rule is not law unless it
ships with a guard registered here. Existing rules migrate over time as a backlog class and do
NOT block current work — that is what makes this adoptable rather than a wall.
WHY A REGISTRY AT ALL. Rules lived in prose across 40+ .cursor/rules files and docs. Prose cannot
be checked, so a rule could be 'law' while nothing on earth enforced it — which is exactly how
financial rows got DELETED under a void-not-delete rule that had been written down for months.
A rule with no guard is a wish; this file is where that becomes visible instead of assumed.
STATUS VALUES
enforced      — a guard file exists and runs in CI. The rule is real.
guard-pending — checkable, but no guard written yet. Honest backlog, non-blocking.
JUDGMENT      — genuinely not machine-checkable (an owner decision, an accounting treatment
call). Recorded so nobody mistakes 'unguarded' for 'unimportant'.
WHAT scripts/verify-law-registry.mjs CHECKS, AND WHAT IT DELIBERATELY DOES NOT. It asserts that
every law whose guard is a path has that FILE ON DISK, plus registry integrity (unique ids, valid
status, no empty rule text). It does NOT run the guards and does NOT re-run typecheck — those
already run in their own steps. Re-running them here would add minutes to every PR and buy
nothing; the check is existence-only so it costs under two seconds. A registry that made every PR
slower would be removed within a week, and then there would be no registry at all.

STATUS `guard-pending` + guard:"PENDING" + planned_guard:"<path>" means the guard is WRITTEN and mutation-proven but not yet in the repo — it is waiting on a verify-step number (Rule 37: a step file may not be authored before its number is on origin/main). The registry records where it WILL live without claiming it exists; the check only demands a file when `guard` is a real path. Registering a path that is not on disk was the registry's own first failure, caught by its own check on the first run.
phased_rule: New rules require a registered guard. Pre-existing rules migrate as backlog and never block a PR.

laws.rule: Every transaction is VOIDABLE; nothing financial is DELETABLE. Voiding a journal entry is a REVERSING entry (reversal_of_line_id / reversed_by_line_id), never a voided_at on a posting line — voiding one line of a balanced entry would leave DR != CR. No financial table may grant DELETE to the app role.
laws.note: Guard written and mutation-proven (4 mutations); baseline seeded at 58 tables from live prod. Awaiting a CC-1-band verify-step number (Rule 37) before it can be wired. Enforcement already live on the two breached tables via DELETE-blocking triggers (ACCT-F130 driver_settlements, ACCT-F131 journal_entry_postings).

laws.rule: TRK / TRANSP / USMCA share nothing. Any resolution of an entity-scoped row by bare id — JOIN or single-read — reachable under bypass_rls OR owner-role RLS must carry an entity predicate, because org.user_accessible_company_ids() returns ALL active companies for the Owner role.
laws.note: Sizing in progress with Cascade. 523 sites are RLS-protected and are NOT defects; the real instances are those reachable with the policy off or under owner-role. Durable fix is a composite FK (driver_id, operating_company_id), not a query patch.

laws.rule: Every journal entry must balance within its operating_company_id: SUM(debit) = SUM(credit), minimum two posting lines, and reversal links must resolve. Never net across entities.
There are no owner holds, no JORGE-APPROVED label, and no approval gate at merge time. Coders merge on green with proof and apply migrations themselves. The safeguard is PROOF, not permission.

A migration whose checksum is already applied under a different filename is a renumber-and-reapply, not a new migration, and must be refused at the runner. A ledger row is not evidence that a migration had an effect.

mdata.load_status_enum must actually contain abandoned / driver_walkoff / driver_no_show. Migration 0094 was recorded applied in both ledgers while the labels were absent for months — assert the EFFECT in pg_enum, never the ledger row.
A raw UUID must never be rendered as a human-facing label; resolve it to a name or display id.

Driver deductions are authorized by the signed HIRE CONTRACT. No per-charge driver e-signature gate may be introduced; requires_acknowledgment must not be set true on driver-liability writes. Company-side sign-off at settlement prep and maker != checker remain.
laws.note: Guard written and selftest-proven (3 mutations). Code fix is LIVE on main (ACCT-F119); only the static guard awaits a verify-step number.

laws.rule: Every TMS-NATIVE postable money event must reach the ledger. QBO-origin rows are refused by design under parallel books and must NEVER be counted as a gap — demanding coverage on the 40,887 cloned rows would report a $65M gap that must never be closed. Invoices count only at status='sent' AND total_cents > 0.
laws.note: Shipped in PR #4528, awaiting merge. Live half is opt-in (GL_POSTING_COVERAGE_LIVE=1) because CI's database is a fixture playground.

laws.rule: The canonical QBO mirror is the INBOUND clone set (mdata.qbo_ap_bills / qbo_ar_invoices / qbo_ar_payments / qbo_purchases / qbo_vendors / qbo_accounts). mdata.qbo_bills and mdata.qbo_invoices are OUTBOUND write-back staging and are empty BY DESIGN — never a sync gap and never a repoint target. accounting.qbo_* entity mirrors are RETIRE.
laws.note: Guard written, 6 mutations including two that fail if bills/invoices are ever repointed at the empty staging tables. Awaiting verify-step 2641.

laws.rule: A bill in status 'draft' is not an approved liability and must not post to the ledger — its amount, vendor and account mapping can still change.
laws.note: Code fix shipped in PR #4540 after bill f8f8e5a4 posted from draft with a NULL bill_number. Guard written with 3 mutations.

laws.rule: Classify row ORIGIN before calling any gap a defect. Import-origin rows (relay_ingest, QBO clones) legitimately lack load links and journal entries; a guard must never redden on them. Load linkage is going-forward only — never invent a load FK.
laws.note: Keys on load_required rather than a row count, so the 1,548-row pre-dispatch cohort can never redden it. Shipped alongside PR #4526.

laws.rule: TRK is the sole asset holder and lessor. TRANSP and USMCA own no assets today, so no PP&E or Accumulated Depreciation accounts belong on their charts; such accounts are added only when a real asset purchase is recorded for that entity. Depreciation lives only on TRK's books.
laws.note: Checkable as a CoA subtype scan scoped to TMS-native rows so the TRANSP QBO mirror never reddens. Not yet written.

laws.rule: All TMS-native data across all three entities is TEST data; the only real financial history is the TRANSP QBO mirror. An empty TMS table is EXPECTED, never a defect. Guards asserting 'real financial data' key on QBO-origin rows.
laws.note: A blanket guard would have to decide what counts as 'real', which is the judgment itself. Enforced instead by the origin test inside each money guard.

laws.rule: TMS never writes back to QuickBooks. QBO is system-of-record for cloned history; posting flags stay per-entity and write-back push flags stay OFF.
laws.note: Partially enforced by the JE push gate and the entity-push refusals in the poster; no single registry-level guard yet.
